profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer with a passion for Front End
profile.summary:
I'm a seasoned and self-taught software engineer with experience in diverse industries such as healthcare, advertising, and industrial power. Currently working at the forefront of full stack development at DXC Technology, I lead teams building web applications, primarily for our healthcare clients.

I'm deeply interested in accessibility, design, and technology's potential to empower individuals and improve lives. As a cancer survivor, I've experienced firsthand the positive impact of patient-centric tools, which greatly simplified my treatment journey. I bring this perspective daily to my work as a developer, striving to create experiences that not only are accessible, but also rooted in the principles of inclusive design.

positions.title: Advisor Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack technical lead building web applications for healthcare clients, mentoring junior developers, working with product owners to define requirements, and collaborating closely with UX designers.
positions.insights: Skills: New Concepts · Microsoft Azure · Responsive Design · Bootstrap · React.js · Git · Code Review · Semantic HTML · Angular · User Experience (UX) · MySQL · Jira · Full-Stack Development · Front end development · PostgreSQL · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · TypeScript

positions.title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical front-end lead on a high-performance engineering team building a mobile field services platform primarily in Angular.

Responsibilities included test-driven development and close collaboration with QA engineers, assisting with writing user stories and acceptance criteria, tasking assignments, and technical oversight. Daily work also involved Yarn, webpack, MongoDB implemented with Mingo, and many other neat things.
positions.insights: Skills: New Concepts · Responsive Design · Git · Code Review · Semantic HTML · MongoDB · Angular · User Experience (UX) · Front end development · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Angular Material · TypeScript

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Front and back end web development using:

• HTML/CSS, Javascript, jQuery
• PHP, ColdFusion
• WordPress, internal/custom CMS
• Foundation & Bootstrap frameworks

Working closely with designers and other web developers in an agile environment. Building responsive, accessible websites for clients across a variety of industries.

positions.title: Web and Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
Web and application development using:

  • HTML(5) & CSS(3)
  • JavaScript/jQuery
  • PHP, ColdFusion
  • Custom and open-source CMS's

Exploring new technologies/processes and collaborating with other developers and designers. Building responsive, accessible websites and applications for a variety of clients and industries.

Clients include:

  • Fireball Whisky
  • Perkins Rowe
  • Entergy New Orleans
  • Eat Gulf Seafood
  • Visit Baton Rouge
  • DuPage Medical Group

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
Freelance web design and web development. Managing project deliverables and deadlines; developing websites in standards-compliant HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery.

Implementing content management systems like WordPress, Magento, Fork.

Clients include and included:

  • The Creole Creamery
  • Attic Monster Design Factory
  • Ridgewood Preparatory School
  • ChapterSpot
positions.insights: Skills: New Concepts · CSS · Semantic HTML · Web Development · User Experience (UX) · HTML · Front end development · JavaScript

positions.title: General Partner
positions.description: Working closely with a partner to plan, design, and develop websites for a variety of clients. E-commerce development using Magento; basic website development using WordPress.

projects.title: MDGuidelines
projects.description: Redesign and modernization of the existing MDGuidelines application for Reed Group. This project required strict adherance to WCAG AA standards, collaboration with and management of offshore development teams, refactoring of legacy code, and development of an entirely new UI.

projects.title: FieldVision
projects.description: Mobile and desktop Angular application used by field engineers during controlled outages at power plants. Agile development with strict performance requirements.
